feature: Research: detecting features with zero behavioral change at contract negotiation time
problem: feat-role-model-config passed evaluator negotiation with all ACs testing file existence/content but none testing runtime behavioral change (model: inherit was still true at negotiation time — the actual behavior change never happened, yet the contract was accepted as a feature). No mechanism existed at contract negotiation time to flag a 'feature' contract where every AC is a grep/file-existence check with no runtime signal.
proposed_solution: Research and recommend the best detection mechanism from three candidates: (A) prompt-only — anti-vacuity rule added to evaluator.md; (B) structural/heuristic — harness_lint.py static check flagging feature contracts where all ACs use grep/file-exists only; (C) hybrid — evaluator rule + harness_lint.py static check with divided responsibility. Output: .harness/docs/research/vacuous-feature-detection.md
